section.name: Navigation & Pages
section.description: Tests for navigation and core pages in Arkade Explorer

case.title: Home page displays with search bar and feature cards

custom.preconds: Browser is open and internet connection is available.
custom.expected: A search bar is visible at the top, and at least 3 feature cards (e.g., for transactions, addresses) are displayed below it.

case.title: Transaction page shows correct transaction details

custom.steps: 1. Search for a valid transaction ID or navigate to /tx/{txid}.
custom.expected: Page loads with transaction ID, inputs, outputs, amounts, and timestamps matching blockchain data.

case.title: Commitment transaction page displays full transaction information

custom.steps: 1. Navigate to a commitment transaction page.
custom.expected: Full details including batch list, tree view, raw hex, inputs/outputs, and timestamps are visible.

case.title: Address page shows VTXO list and statistics

custom.steps: 1. Search for a valid address or navigate to /address/{addr}.
custom.expected: Statistics card (balance, received, VTXO counts) and paginated VTXO list are displayed.

custom.steps: 1. Navigate to an invalid URL (e.g., https://explorer.arkade.sh/invalid).
custom.expected: A 404 error page is shown with a user-friendly message.

case.title: Header navigation works on all pages

custom.preconds: On any non-home page (e.g., transaction page).
custom.expected: Navigates to the correct page without full reload.

custom.steps: 1. Navigate to multiple pages (home, tx, address).
custom.expected: Footer with links/copyright is visible on every page.
